Name: Sorren - Original NPC
Author: annachibi2
Description:
[center][b][size=4]***Hey guys! silvermoonchan here! annachibi2 is retiring from Sorren so I will be taking over maintaining him from now on. I now bring you Sorren 2.0!!!*** [/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Sorren is a little grumpy and shy at first, but once you get to know him, you'll see he's really just a big teddy bear. Find out what brought this almost-middle-aged miner to Stardew Valley and what secrets are hidden beneath his gruff exterior by befriending him and maybe even marrying him!


[size=4][b]Sorren shows up at the Saloon a day after the landslide unblocks the Mines on Spring 5th[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]a ruggedly handsome miner[/*]
[*]marriageable[/*]
[*]fully gender-neutral dialogue[/*]
[*]tragic backstory[/*]
[*]he's shirtless in one of his heart events eheh[/*]
[*]shows up at festivals! (except Spirit's Eve)[/*]
[*]compatible with SVE (not required)[/*]
[*]custom spouse room![/*]
[*]a variety of optional alternative portraits[/*]
[*]optional seasonal portraits courtesy of CubicPoison, whose assets were open for use, and modified seasonal sprites by seanfletcher who gave me permission![/*]
[*]an actual room now in the Saloon attic via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Attic and Basement[/url] (he's in the far upper right bedroom)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requires:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Attic and Basement[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23529](CP) Spouse Room Renovation[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b]Sorren's Details:[/b]
[spoiler]
Schedule:
- Spring: 6:30am goes to the Beach, 12pm Saloon, 3pm Mountain near mine bridge, 11pm Saloon
- Summer: 6:30am goes to Mountain tree west of Linus, 12pm Saloon, 3pm Mountain near mine bridge, 11pm Saloon
- Fall: 6:30am goes to Forest by the lake dock, 2pm Mountain near mine bridge, 11pm Saloon
- Winter: 6:30am goes to Mountain tree west of Linus, 3pm Mountain near mine bridge, 8pm Saloon
- Rain: 6:30am goes to Mountain tree west of Linus, 11am Saloon, 3pm Mountain tree west of Linus, 8pm Saloon
- Mon & Tues - 6:30am goes to Beach, 11am Blacksmith, 4pm Town bridge west of Blacksmith, 8pm Saloon

Event Guide:
- 2 hearts: Enter the Mine from 4pm to midnight
- 4 hearts: Enter the Mountain from 8am to 4pm when it's sunny
- 6 hearts: Enter the Saloon from 8pm to midnight
- 8 hearts: Enter the Mountain from 6am to 3pm when it's sunny
- 10 hearts: After receiving a letter from Sorren inviting you, enter the Beach from 7am to 2pm on a sunny spring or summer day

Birthday: Fall 23

Gift Preferences (Partial List):
- Loves: Salmon Dinner, Fried Mushroom, Wine
- Likes: Driftwood, Lobster, Mushrooms (besides Red & Purple)
- Dislikes: Salad, Coleslaw, Algae Soup, Pale Broth[/spoiler]
